verdict.rationale: Docs confirm individual developers can log in with a personal claude.ai account (Pro/Max subscription) instead of managing an API key, and that API-key auth is optional/alternate. However, evidence only references Pro/Max subscription login, not an explicit free tier for Claude Code — missing for 10: explicit confirmation that a free/no-cost claude.ai account grants Claude Code access, and independent user corroboration of free-tier login flow.
